historical_scope: Present-build controls review, not a historical event reconstruction. Initial tank position and station are staged; the original game inventory is retained. Enemy fire is held for an isolated review.
limitations: Scripted Game inputs, not native OS mouse/keyboard capture. Original gameplay audio is retained. State checks and visual review are both required.
title: Physical paper map, persistent pencil and pin through in/out zoom
caption: SCRIPTED INPUT / PHYSICAL MAP / WHEEL ZOOM
input_audit: Map open/close uses set_map_held, zoom steps use the native wheel/+/- zoom_held_map API; moving the pencil uses zoom-scaled native mouse deltas and shared focus. Neither paper data, marks, sheet awards nor camera FOV is replaced. Original playtest map availability is disclosed, not claimed as campaign exploration.
visual_acceptance: Real folded paper is lit and occluded by the cabin.
Pencil and pin stay registered as paper approaches the eye and returns to overview.
Zoom changes readable paper area, not world camera magnification.
